note: val only; every system tuned on val; this bundle has no test split. G3 is one real recording (v11, 44 answered notes, no ground truth).
rule: state_R2.json round3_selection_rule_fixed_now (G1 keep_table_v1 logic, G2 / G3 / rank LB_select_v1 logic, both copied)

r2_copyhmbold_v1.name: r2_copyhmbold_v1
r2_copyhmbold_v1.what: round-2 champion: melody prior + copy model + harmonic memory, lower attack cost (kappa 0.75)

r2_copyhm_v1.name: r2_copyhm_v1
r2_copyhm_v1.what: round 2: melody prior + copy model + harmonic memory

r2_copy_v1.name: r2_copy_v1
r2_copy_v1.what: round 2: melody prior + copy model of the song repeats + hedged hear

r2_copysafe_v1.name: r2_copysafe_v1
r2_copysafe_v1.what: round 2: r2_copy_v1 with a 1.5x attack cost on unheard notes

r1_A_prior_v1.name: r1_A_prior_v1
r1_A_prior_v1.what: round 1 idea A: melody prior, expected-value plan, posterior hear

r1_C_revoice_v2.name: r1_C_revoice_v2
r1_C_revoice_v2.what: round 1 idea C: learned forecaster, revoicing (close to reactive)

r3_D_reghm_v1.name: r3_D_reghm_v1
r3_D_reghm_v1.what: D: register adapter around r2_copyhm_v1, no guard

r3_D_regsafe_v1.name: r3_D_regsafe_v1
r3_D_regsafe_v1.what: D: register adapter around r2_copysafe_v1, no guard

r3_D_regguard_v1.name: r3_D_regguard_v1
r3_D_regguard_v1.what: D: register adapter around r2_copy_v1 + out-of-key hearing guard (hold_sil)

r3_D_regguardsafe_v1.name: r3_D_regguardsafe_v1
r3_D_regguardsafe_v1.what: D: register adapter around r2_copysafe_v1 + out-of-key hearing guard (hold_sil)

r3_E_trk_v1.name: r3_E_trk_v1
r3_E_trk_v1.what: E: tracker-aware hear on r2_copyhm_v1 (tau_t 0.15, harsh_max 0.2)

r3_E_trkhold_v1.name: r3_E_trkhold_v1
r3_E_trkhold_v1.what: E: r3_E_trk_v1 + tracker posterior for her held note (hold_trk)

r3_E_trksafe_v1.name: r3_E_trksafe_v1
r3_E_trksafe_v1.what: E: stricter tracker guard (tau_t 0.12, harsh_max 0.1, sil_v -0.1)

r3_F_guard_v1.name: r3_F_guard_v1
r3_F_guard_v1.what: F: r2_copyhm_v1 + stumble guards + cautious posterior hear, w_x 0.2

r3_F_calm_v1.name: r3_F_calm_v1
r3_F_calm_v1.what: F: guard_v1 with a hop block (hop_bad 0.5), w_x 0.25

r3_F_bold_v1.name: r3_F_bold_v1
r3_F_bold_v1.what: F: guard_v1 guards on r2_copyhmbold_v1, w_x 0.25

r3_X_regtrkdk_v1.name: r3_X_regtrkdk_v1
r3_X_regtrkdk_v1.what: X: D register adapter + E tracker-aware hear (trkholdk) + key-aware doubt rule (0.7, keep); no stumble guards

r3_X_regtrkst_v1.name: r3_X_regtrkst_v1
r3_X_regtrkst_v1.what: X: D register adapter + E tracker-aware hear (trkholdk) + F stumble guards (g_mu 0.1) + key-aware doubt rule (0.7, noatt)

r3_X_regtrkstsafe_v1.name: r3_X_regtrkstsafe_v1
r3_X_regtrkstsafe_v1.what: X: r3_X_regtrkst_v1 with the doubt rule widened (out-of-key and P(misheard) >= 0.15, noatt)

r3_X_regtrkstfree_v1.name: r3_X_regtrkstfree_v1
r3_X_regtrkstfree_v1.what: X: r3_X_regtrkst_v1 without the doubt rule (shows its cost; fails G3)
